parsed.why: Criminalisation up to 14 years, death-penalty risk in northern Sharia, police torture/extortion, unprosecuted trans killing; no protections. Outing invites arrest, extortion, violence.
National morality law selectively enforced, official decree framing LGBT as security threat, mob attacks on trans women, trans traveller died in custody, raids; subnational caning.
Self-ID, anti-discrimination and hate-crime laws, functioning courts; but rising violence, dating-app ambushes, hate-crime recording gaps. State protection generally operates.
No gender-identity law; police refuse LGBT death probes; trans women in custody abused by birth sex; high social hostility. Hate-crime law and one police conviction are positives.
Anti-discrimination law, hate-crime prosecutions and court rulings protect; but presidential/ministerial hostility, high discrimination, prisons unprepared, detention practice inconsistent.
